name: Gemful
source:
After the Opium War, China began to fall into a semi-colonial and semi-feudal society with fierce social conflicts. On the other hand, the influx of Western technology, culture, and art has led to a trend of pursuing fashion as Western in Chinese society.

"Gemful" is a interactive fiction based on the above. Players will play the role of a talented but neglected second daughter of a wealthy family. She has grown up with her beautiful elder sister and has always lacked attention and confidence.

One day, she wakes up from an illusion and is then taken by her sister to watch the fireworks show at the Lantern Festival. Along the way, she encounter dogging ghost shadow, impoverished beggar, crying child, and cunning peacock merchant... She will face various situations and choices, and in each choice, she will rediscover herself and eventually overcome her inner demons.

[From [url=https://ifangastic.itch.io/gemful]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
鴉片戰爭後，中國開始淪為半殖民地半封建社會，社會矛盾尖銳。與此同時，西方技術、文化與藝術的湧入，也讓中國社會興起了以西洋事物為時尚的風潮。

《Gemful》正是以此為背景的互動小說。玩家將扮演一位富裕人家中才華出眾、卻備受冷落的二女兒。她與美麗的姊姊一同長大，始終缺少關注與自信。

一天，她從幻境中醒來，隨後被姊姊帶去觀看元宵節的煙火表演。途中，她遇到糾纏不休的鬼影、窮困的乞丐、哭泣的孩子，以及狡猾的孔雀商人……她將面對各種處境與抉擇，在一次次選擇中重新認識自己，最終戰勝內心的魔障。
